name: CFBI regional nearest-neighbour evidence for SAM2 memory reads
status: frozen candidate; engineering gate required before cohort run

prior_method.paper: Collaborative Video Object Segmentation by Foreground-Background Integration
prior_method.reused_code: The pinned author global_matching implementation and its unchanged pairwise-distance / nearest-neighbour helpers are loaded from external/CFBI/networks/layers/matching.py.

hypothesis: Native SAM2 already attends to all stored memory. CFBI-style class-conditioned nearest-neighbour evidence may help the read distinguish useful foreground, boundary and background matches without selecting or dropping frames.

method.query: SAM2 q_proj(query) before rotary encoding, pooled from 64x64 to 16x16.
method.memory: SAM2 k_proj(memory content) before rotary encoding; object-pointer tokens are excluded from the auxiliary matcher and remain in native attention.
method.regions: Per-frame predicted-mask labels on the stored memory's 64x64 token grid. Within each 4x4 pooling cell, features are averaged separately for every region present. This preserves foreground, mixed-boundary and background evidence in a coarse local grid.
method.matching: Call pinned CFBI global_matching over every stored memory frame and every region-specific pooled key. It returns three 16x16 nearest-neighbour distance maps, one per region. Missing regions receive neutral zero evidence.
method.integration: A zero-initialized 1x1 projection maps the three evidence maps to a bounded residual added to each native cross-attention output. The native attention computation, stored memory, frame schedule, pointers, image encoder, memory encoder and decoder remain unchanged.
method.frame_policy: Use SAM2's unchanged native frame schedule; do not select, reject or classify memory frames.

required: zero-projection replay is bit-identical to native masks, scores, writes and cache state
all four memory-attention layers receive finite regional evidence
all spatial memory tokens are accounted for and pointer tokens remain unchanged
CFBI source revision is verified and its global matcher matches a direct author-function call
after one update, all four projections receive finite nonzero gradients and full clip propagation completes

training.loss: Existing autoregressive SAM2 decoder mask Dice/BCE plus object-presence loss on each sampled clip.

evaluation.cohort: All 21 promptable PolypGen sequences; seq1 and seq7 excluded because they have no positive first-frame prompt mask.
evaluation.design: Three sequence-grouped folds. The same sequences have informed earlier development, so results are exploratory and not independent confirmation.
evaluation.primary: Equal-sequence mean present-frame Dice on out-of-fold full propagation.
evaluation.meaningful_screen: At least +0.01 equal-sequence mean Dice, positive delta on at least 14/21 sequences, and no increase in pooled GT-empty false alarms.

decision: If the engineering gate fails, do not launch the cohort run. If the frozen screen fails, report the negative result without tuning on these sequences.
